dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse interior angle of approximately 165 degrees at the transition from melon to rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced polygonal mesh artifacts and vertex-shading anomalies visible on the anterior rostrum and dorsal surface.
